companyAnnouncements: agent-fork: a CLI plus companion skill that forks a running Claude Code or Codex session into a new branch and verified Git worktree carrying your uncommitted work, then prints the exact command to continue the conversation there. Commands: /agent-fork (fork this session; $agent-fork in Codex). Build with 'make check' then 'just all'. Start at README.md; design corpus in DESIGN-DECISIONS.md and REQUIREMENTS.md.
